title: A Trip to Spain
setting: A trip from a home in China to a sunny beach town in Spain.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress

sentences.en: Dan and Aiko wake up early at home.
sentences.zh: 丹和爱子一大早在家醒来。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress wake up in bed, packed suitcases by the door, dawn at the window.

sentences.en: They take a taxi to the airport quickly.
sentences.zh: 他们赶紧坐出租车去机场。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress jump into a yellow taxi with their suitcases.

sentences.en: Aiko holds their airplane tickets in her hand.
sentences.zh: 爱子手里拿着他们的机票。
sentences.scene_prompt: Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress holds two plane tickets at an airport, an airplane outside the big window.

sentences.en: They fly from China to Spain.
sentences.zh: 他们从中国飞往西班牙。
sentences.scene_prompt: An airplane flies high above the clouds over a sunny sea.

sentences.en: A bus drives them along a sunny road.
sentences.zh: 一辆公共汽车载着他们沿着阳光明媚的道路行驶。
sentences.scene_prompt: A bus drives along a sunny coast road; Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress look out of its window.

sentences.en: Dan looks at a map to find their hotel.
sentences.zh: 丹看地图找他们的酒店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt studies a paper map on a street corner while Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress points the way.

sentences.en: They stay at a small hotel near the beach.
sentences.zh: 他们住在海滩附近的一家小酒店。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress stand on the balcony of a small white hotel above a sandy beach.

sentences.en: Every morning they ride bikes by the sea.
sentences.zh: 每天早上他们在海边骑自行车。
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with short brown hair and a blue shirt and Aiko, a young woman with long black hair and a yellow dress ride bicycles along the seaside in the morning sun.
